plan: This is a single-round auction with only three bidders. My value is $30. To maximize profit, I need to win when my value exceeds the second-highest bid. I will bid slightly above what I estimate the other bidders will offer, but conservatively. Given the range of possible values (0-49), a bid of $15.50 seems reasonable. It's low enough to avoid overpaying, yet high enough to win against likely low-value opponents. The worst case is losing to a bid between $15.51 and $30.

This is below my value, but should win against low bids.
